trait:audio.multi-speaker.rule: Speech from two or more speakers.

trait:audio.multi-window.rule: Speech longer than 30 s, media's default window limit, so it is cut into more than one window.

trait:audio.narrowband.rule: Audio sampled at 8 kHz or less, such as telephone speech.

trait:audio.noisy.rule: Speech under audible background noise, music, or reverberation, or from a degraded recording.

trait:audio.non-english.rule: Speech in a language other than English.

trait:audio.none.rule: A video with no audio stream.

trait:audio.spontaneous.rule: Unscripted speech, such as a conversation, interview, or meeting, not read aloud.

trait:charset.declared.rule: A message or markup that declares a charset other than UTF-8 for a part, or a header with MIME encoded-words.

trait:charset.legacy-other.rule: Text with no byte order mark in a legacy encoding other than windows-1252, such as Shift_JIS, GB 18030, or KOI8-R.

trait:charset.utf-16-no-bom.rule: Text with no byte order mark encoded as UTF-16, big- or little-endian.

trait:charset.windows-1252.rule: Text with no byte order mark that isn't UTF-8 and is windows-1252 or Latin-1, the encoding docproc falls back to.

trait:scale.large-file.rule: A file of 100 MiB or more.

trait:scale.large-sheet.rule: A worksheet whose Markdown passes 256 KiB, so docproc-ooxml splits it across more than one rows line.

trait:scale.long-media.rule: Audio or video of 30 minutes or more.

trait:scale.many-entries.rule: An archive holding 1,000 entries or more.

trait:scale.many-messages.rule: A mail store or mbox holding 1,000 messages or more.

trait:scale.many-pages.rule: A document of 100 pages or more.

trait:scale.oversized-page.rule: A PDF page whose rendering at the request's DPI passes its MaxPixels, so docproc renders it at a lower DPI.

trait:scan.camera.rule: A page photographed rather than scanned flat, with perspective, uneven light, or curvature.

trait:scan.degraded.rule: A scan with visible noise, skew, bleed-through, or under 200 dpi.

trait:scan.handwriting.rule: Handwritten text, scanned, photographed, or stored as ink.

trait:scan.printed.rule: Printed text captured as an image by a scanner or a camera.

trait:script.arabic.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence in the Arabic script, written right to left.

trait:script.cyrillic.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence in the Cyrillic script.

trait:script.devanagari.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence in the Devanagari script.

trait:script.greek.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence in the Greek script.

trait:script.han.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence in Han characters.

trait:script.hangul.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence in Korean Hangul.

trait:script.hebrew.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence in the Hebrew script, written right to left.

trait:script.kana.rule: Its text holds at least a sentence with Japanese hiragana or katakana.

trait:script.mixed.rule: Its text holds sentences in two or more scripts, Latin counting as one.

trait:text-layer.none.rule: A PDF none of whose pages has a text layer by docproc's document.HasText.

trait:text-layer.ocr.rule: A PDF whose text layer was made by OCR: invisible text laid over page images.

trait:text-layer.partial.rule: A PDF some of whose pages have a text layer by docproc's document.HasText and some don't.

trait:text-layer.unmapped.rule: A PDF whose text layer reads as the wrong characters because a font lacks a Unicode mapping.

feature:animation.rule: An animated GIF, WebP, or AVIF.

feature:attached-picture.rule: Audio or video carrying an attached picture, such as cover art.

feature:attachment-by-reference.rule: A message attachment stored by reference, with no file of its own.

feature:attachments.rule: A message with at least one attached file.

feature:charts.rule: A chart in an OOXML document, sheet, or slide.

feature:comments.rule: A comment anchored to content in a docx or a pptx.

feature:dates.rule: An xlsx cell with a date number format.

feature:embedded-messages.rule: A message attached inside another message.

feature:embedded-objects.rule: An embedded package, an OLE object, or a OneNote embedded file.

feature:equations.rule: A math equation: an OOXML equation or a OneNote math run.

feature:folders.rule: A mail store whose messages sit in more than one folder.

feature:footnotes.rule: A footnote or endnote in a docx.

feature:forms.rule: A PDF with an AcroForm whose fields are filled or empty.

feature:formulas.rule: An xlsx cell holding a formula.

feature:html-body.rule: A message whose only body is HTML.

feature:hyperlinks.rule: An external hyperlink in an OOXML document, a OneNote page, or a message body.

feature:image-ocr.rule: A OneNote image carrying OneNote's own recognised text.

feature:ink.rule: Handwriting or a drawing stored as ink strokes on a OneNote page.

feature:inline-images.rule: A message body showing an image inline, as a data: URI or a cid: related part.

feature:merged-cells.rule: A table with a cell merged across rows or columns.

feature:multi-column.rule: A page laid out in two or more text columns.

feature:multi-page-image.rule: A TIFF holding more than one page.

feature:multiple-streams.rule: Audio or video with more than one audio stream or more than one video stream.

feature:nested-tables.rule: A table inside another table's cell.

feature:non-note-items.rule: A contact, appointment, or task in a mail store.

feature:note-tags.rule: A OneNote paragraph carrying a note tag, such as a to-do box.

feature:orientation.rule: A picture with a stored rotation or mirror to apply before it shows upright.

feature:page-revisions.rule: A OneNote page with earlier revisions besides its latest.

feature:picture-layout.rule: A picture covered by another, placed off its slide or page, or cropped away.

feature:pictures.rule: A picture embedded in a document, sheet, slide, OneNote page, or message body.

feature:portfolio.rule: A PDF portfolio: a cover page over embedded documents.

feature:protected-section.rule: A OneNote section that needs a password, as an input or inside a notebook.

feature:rights-managed.rule: A rights-managed message, its content in a message.rpmsg attachment.

feature:section-groups.rule: A OneNote notebook with a section inside a section group.

feature:signature-fields.rule: A PDF with a signature field, signed or not.

feature:smartart.rule: A SmartArt diagram in an OOXML document or slide.

feature:smime-opaque.rule: A message whose content is an opaque S/MIME part, application/pkcs7-mime.

feature:speaker-notes.rule: A pptx slide with speaker notes.

feature:tables.rule: A table: in an OOXML document or slide, a OneNote page, or laid out on a PDF page.

feature:text-boxes.rule: Text in an OOXML text box or shape.

feature:threads.rule: Messages that reply to one another, linked by In-Reply-To, References, or Conversation-Index.

feature:tnef-part.rule: A message with a TNEF part, winmail.dat.

feature:tracked-changes.rule: A docx holding insertions or deletions recorded as tracked changes.

feature:transparency.rule: A picture with an alpha channel or a transparent background.
